title: Daily digest: Level 3 Elevated
message: Quiet night. Oil fell about 5% as Trump signalled restraint on Iran, but Hormuz is still shut, so fuel stays dear. Elsewhere: a gang claims it hacked Visa and Mastercard via a supplier - unconfirmed, cards work normally here. Do: ignore texts about a 'Visa security issue'. Hills fire danger High today and Friday, gusts to 60 km/h.
